why: SQLite full-text search is not wired up yet
SQLite keeps all text as UTF-8 and has no charset conversion; wpdb asks for it only for tables in a non-Unicode charset
PostgreSQL's setseed() seeds the whole session, not one call, so MySQL's repeatable RAND(n) has no faithful form
MySQL's spatial types need PostGIS, which the PostgreSQL engine does not assume
MySQL stored procedures are not translated (their CREATE PROCEDURE bodies are a parse gap), so there is no procedure to call
